WHY THIS IS A BOARD-LEVEL RISK
SAP ends mainstream support for ECC on 31 December 2027 — and the migrations routinely overrun. Across 200 large enterprises, only 8% finished S/4HANA on schedule and roughly 60% blew their budget; nearly half of SAP’s 35,000 ECC customers are still on legacy ERP. Cognixa makes scope, fit-to-standard and cutover provable — so the deadline doesn’t force a rushed, over-budget go-live.

Grounded in your real system — not just the documented process
Cognixa scans the running ECC landscape — custom code, configuration and usage telemetry — and reconciles it against the Signavio process. Every fit-gap mapping is based on what you actually do, then governed to clean core with human sign-off.
Read reality → map → govern
TEACH ONCE → APPLY ACROSS THE ESTATE
One decision generalises to every look-alike — no model retraining
ONE-SHOT IP
A consultant dispositioned ZSD_REBATE_ENGINE → Rebuild · BTP. Cognixa learned the shape of that decision — same Z-table reads, same RICEFW class, same usage band — and found 47 structurally-similar objects across the 4,820. It proposes the same disposition for all of them, each still human-approvable.
Instead of dispositioning 47 objects one-by-one
47 objects auto-dispositioned from one human decision — ≈11 consultant-days saved on this engagement alone. The pattern is now saved to the clean-core ruleset, so it scores objects like this automatically on the next client — the IP compounds. Reset demo

What AI can’t fix alone — the migration killers

Automated tooling clears the deterministic work — scanning code, fixing syntax, generating tests. What it can’t settle is a business rule no two people define the same way. Cognixa carries one object through both layers: the engine does the repeatable analysis, a named owner makes the judgement call — early, while changing it is still cheap.

BEFORE THE ENGINE · PROCESS READINESS

You can't write the target process — that's the engine's job.

Fit-to-standard needs a target, but the business can't define one without knowing SAP first — the chicken-and-egg that stalls every blueprint. Cognixa never demands a to-be. Tell it what you have today — maps, documents, tribal knowledge, or nothing — and it aligns that to the SAP standard to derive the target and the deltas for you.

This is the one interface that crosses two systems of record — SuccessFactors owns the employee & org assignment, S/4 owns the cost-centre posting. A cost-centre effective-date mismatch silently mis-posts labour cost, and no single team can see both sides. So neither lead signs alone — both co-sign the contract before Build.

Why this beats a blind converter
Design-driven. Each change is checked against the signed spec — code serves the agreed solution, not just the old behaviour.
Clean-core routing. Eligible logic moves to BTP side-by-side — upgrade-safe, not re-dumped in the core.
End-to-end. Not just analysis — through test and transport to a running S/4 system, under sign-off.
SYSTEM CONVERSION · BROWNFIELD
A pure technical move from SAP ECC to S/4HANA — same processes, same config, same history, no new features. Cognixa runs the SAP-standard conversion path (Readiness Check → SUM/DMO → mandatory conversions → cutover) with custom code remediated and every step evidenced. Worked example: a mining enterprise on ECC EhP8 / Oracle.
THIS PROJECT
System Conversion (Brownfield)
Convert the existing system in place. Keeps config, data & history. Fastest to S/4, lowest business change.
New Implementation (Greenfield)
Rebuild clean on S/4. Best when redesigning processes — more change, longer.
Selective Data Transition
Mix — carry chosen config/data, leave the rest. Consolidation & carve-outs.
